name: Whitefield
notes: Most Whitefield airport runs go via Budigere Cross (NH-648) or Hennur Road, skipping city traffic almost entirely.
Avoid the ORR Marathahalli–KR Puram stretch between 6–10 PM; if you must travel then, add 20–30 minutes.
For early-morning flights (pickups between 3–6 AM) the roads are clear and the trip usually takes about 75 minutes.

faqs.question: How early should I leave Whitefield for a 6 AM flight?
faqs.answer: Leave by 3:00–3:15 AM. Pre-dawn roads make it roughly a 75-minute drive via Budigere Cross, which lands you at departures around 4:30 AM — the 90-minute buffer domestic airlines recommend.

faqs.question: Which route will the driver take from ITPL or Brookefield?
faqs.answer: Usually Whitefield–Hoskote Road to Budigere Cross and onto the airport road, or via Hennur if you're on the Kadugodi side. Drivers pick live based on traffic; both avoid Silk Board-style choke points.

faqs.question: Do you do airport pickups to Whitefield at midnight or later?
faqs.answer: Yes, we run 24/7. Share your flight number when booking — we track the arrival and the driver is waiting even if the flight is delayed.

faqs.question: Is the ₹899 fare fixed, or surge-priced?
faqs.answer: It's a fixed day-and-night fare for a sedan from anywhere in Whitefield to KIA. Tolls are extra at actuals; there's no surge, ever.

name: Electronic City
notes: Two main corridors: the elevated expressway to Silk Board then ORR–Hebbal, or NICE Road towards Tumkur Road joining the airport highway — our drivers choose based on live traffic.
Between 5–10 PM the Silk Board–ORR corridor crawls; in peak hours we default to NICE Road even though it's a few kilometres longer.
This is the longest common airport run in Bangalore — allow the full 2 hours in the evening peak, closer to 90 minutes early morning.

faqs.question: How early should I leave Electronic City for a 9 AM flight?
faqs.answer: By 5:45–6:00 AM. The morning build-up on Hosur Road starts after 7 AM, so an early start keeps it to about 95 minutes and gives you a proper check-in buffer.

faqs.question: Will the driver take NICE Road, and who pays that toll?
faqs.answer: In the evening peak, yes — NICE Road is usually 30–40 minutes faster than Silk Board. All tolls, NICE Road included, are billed at actuals on top of the ₹1,099 sedan fare.

faqs.question: Do you cover Chandapura and Hosa Road at the same fare?
faqs.answer: Yes — Phase 1, Phase 2, Neeladri Nagar, Hosa Road and Chandapura are all covered at the flat Electronic City fare.

faqs.question: Can I book a cab from the airport to Electronic City for a late-night arrival?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We monitor your flight and the driver meets you at arrivals with a name board. Night drops via NICE Road are quick — often under 90 minutes.

name: Koramangala
notes: The usual run is Inner Ring Road → Domlur → Mekhri Circle → Hebbal flyover and onto the elevated airport expressway.
Evening peak (5–9 PM) on Inner Ring Road and at Hebbal adds 20–30 minutes; early mornings take just over an hour.

faqs.question: How early should I leave Koramangala for a 7 AM flight?
faqs.answer: Leave by 4:15–4:30 AM. At that hour the run via Inner Ring Road and Hebbal takes about 65–70 minutes, putting you at the terminal 90 minutes before departure.

faqs.question: Is pickup from any block the same fare?
faqs.answer: Yes — all eight blocks plus Ejipura, ST Bed and Jakkasandra fall under the flat ₹899 sedan fare to KIA.

faqs.question: What if my flight lands at 1 AM — will a cab really show up?
faqs.answer: Yes. Airport pickups run round the clock, we track the flight, and night-time drops to Koramangala typically take barely an hour on empty roads.

name: HSR Layout
notes: Standard route is Agara → Inner Ring Road / Koramangala → Mekhri Circle → Hebbal; the ORR–Marathahalli alternative helps when the city side is jammed.
The 27th Main and Agara junction area slows sharply between 6–9 PM; add 25 minutes if departing in that window.

faqs.question: How early should I leave HSR for a 6:30 AM flight?
faqs.answer: By 3:30 AM. Pre-dawn, the drive is about 80 minutes via Inner Ring Road and Hebbal, which gets you to check-in with the standard buffer intact.

faqs.question: Are all seven sectors charged the same ₹899?
faqs.answer: Yes — Sectors 1 through 7, plus Agara, Bommanahalli and the Haralur Road side, are all one flat sedan fare.

faqs.question: Evening flight around 8 PM — when should I book the pickup?
faqs.answer: Ask for a 4:30–5:00 PM pickup. Evening peak through Koramangala and Hebbal makes this a 100–110 minute run; earlier beats the worst of it.

faqs.question: Can I get an SUV instead of a sedan for extra luggage?
faqs.answer: Yes — SUVs and Innovas are available on the same route; the fare differs by vehicle class. Tell us your luggage count on WhatsApp and we'll recommend the right car.

name: Indiranagar
notes: One of the smoothest central pickups: straight up through Ulsoor/Old Madras Road to Hebbal and onto the elevated expressway.
100 Feet Road and CMH Road crawl between 6–9 PM; drivers loop via Swami Vivekananda Road metro side when needed.

faqs.question: How early should I leave Indiranagar for an 8 AM flight?
faqs.answer: By 5:30 AM. Morning traffic is light until about 7 AM, so the run to KIA takes roughly an hour, landing you at the terminal 90 minutes ahead.

faqs.question: Is the fare the same from Domlur or Old Airport Road?
faqs.answer: Yes — the whole Indiranagar belt including Domlur, HAL 2nd Stage and Jeevanbheemanagar is a flat ₹899 by sedan.

faqs.question: Do you offer meet-and-greet for arrivals into Indiranagar homes?
faqs.answer: Yes — for airport pickups the driver waits at the arrivals exit with a name board, helps with luggage, and we track your flight so delays never strand you.

name: Yelahanka
notes: Yelahanka is the closest zone to KIA we serve — flat ₹899 and usually 25–40 minutes door to gate.
The route joins NH-44 (the airport highway) almost immediately, so even peak-hour delays rarely add more than 10–15 minutes.

faqs.question: How early should I leave Yelahanka for a 6 AM flight?
faqs.answer: A 4:15 AM pickup is comfortable — the drive is 25–30 minutes at that hour, and you're at departures well before the 90-minute mark.

faqs.question: Why is the fare ₹899 when Yelahanka is so close?
faqs.answer: ₹899 is our minimum airport fare for a sedan — it covers the driver's dead mileage to reach you and the return. It's still the cheapest fixed airport fare on our card.

faqs.question: Do you cover Jakkur and Kogilu under the Yelahanka fare?
faqs.answer: Yes — New Town, Judicial Layout, Attur, Kogilu and Jakkur all fall in the same flat-fare zone.
